title: Scope → Framework → Workspace (Assisted and Bulk)
env: Environment: dtp.ltsgroup.tech (web test) · Screenshots taken 05 Nov 2026 · Prepared by QA
intro: This flow shows how one scope gets its workspaces. SGS prepares two kinds of framework: an imported framework for Assisted workspaces and a NirmatAI framework for Bulk workspaces. The customer creates one scope and opens both kinds of workspace on it.

SGS Portal = the portal at /ops used by SGS Admins and SGS consultants. Screenshots taken before 06 Nov 2026 show its old header name "Operations Console"; the web now shows "SGS Portal". It is the same portal.

Test data: scope "[QA] D05 Smoke Assisted Org 0851", workspaces "[QA] D05 Smoke Assisted WS 0851" and "[QA] D05 Smoke Bulk WS 0851". Some screenshots are reused from Flow 3 and Flow 5. Red boxes and labels were added for this document.

steps.what: Prepare a framework for Assisted workspaces: import it and activate it.
steps.result: Imported framework is Activated and offered for Assisted workspaces.
body: The framework is imported from the Excel template as Draft. After checking its requirements, SGS activates it. Full detail in Flow 3.
shots: Review and import: name, code, version and content counts, then Import as Draft.
Framework Activated: available to customers of SGS Taiwan.

steps.where: SGS Portal > Frameworks > Sync from NirmatAI
steps.what: Prepare a framework for Bulk workspaces: sync it from NirmatAI and activate it.
steps.result: NirmatAI framework (code NAI-<id>) is Activated and offered for Bulk workspaces.
body: NirmatAI creates and enables the standard; SGS runs Sync, checks the work products and activates it. Full detail in Flow 5.
shots: Sync from NirmatAI and the synced frameworks (source NirmatAI).
NAI-107 Activated with 35 work products from NirmatAI.

steps.result: Scope created; its page has Create workspace.
body: A scope is the part of the organisation that is certified: the organisation, a product or a system.

steps.what: Choose the kind of workspace for the scope.
steps.result: Two choices: Assisted workspace and Bulk upload workspace.
body: Both kinds start from the same scope page. One scope can have one active workspace per standard.
shots: Create workspace menu on the scope page: Assisted workspace or Bulk upload workspace.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Scope > Create workspace > Assisted workspace
steps.what: Create the Assisted workspace from the imported framework.
steps.result: Assisted workspace created with the requirements of the chosen tier.
shots: Step 2 Workspace details: name, cycle and tier.
Assisted workspace created: 61 requirements in scope for tier Medium.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Scope > Create workspace > Bulk upload workspace
steps.what: Create the Bulk workspace on the same scope from the NirmatAI framework.
body: Only NirmatAI frameworks activated by SGS are listed. There is no tier for Bulk.
shots: Step 1 Standard: only the activated NirmatAI framework.
Step 2 Workspace details: same scope, name and cycle; no tier.
Bulk workspace created: the documents page opens, ready for upload.

steps.what: Check the result: one scope with both workspaces.
steps.result: The scope lists the Bulk and the Assisted workspace; the Workspaces list shows their mode.
shots: Scope detail: Workspaces card lists both workspaces.
Workspaces list: Mode Bulk upload or Assisted; tier only for Assisted.

tables.heading: Assisted and Bulk at a glance
rows: Imported by SGS from the Excel template
NirmatAI creates and enables the standard; SGS Admin syncs and activates
Upload documents in bulk, map to work products (optional), request the audit
SGS approves; documents are sent to NirmatAI for the audit
One active workspace per scope and standard; a new cycle archives the previous one

blocked: Sign-in on the SGS environment with Microsoft Entra.
The test environment uses a mock sign-in; Entra is set up only on the SGS DEV/UAT environment.
Customer Admin and SGS Admin can sign in to their portals through Entra.
NirmatAI connection on the SGS environment
Sync from NirmatAI for the Bulk framework.
The NirmatAI certificate is not yet installed on the SGS environment.
After the certificate is installed: Sync brings the NirmatAI standards.
